profile.headline: Software Engineer for Golf Course Management Services
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer in Golf Services
profile.summary:
With a background in Computer Science and Mathematics from UAH, I have a deep passion for problem-solving using logic and analytical skills. My particular interests lie in finite mathematics, including finite groups and discrete structures, as well as computer operating systems and software principles. I also have a fascination with the formalization of Einstein's Theories of Relativity—both special and general—though I acknowledge that this passion isn't very marketable.

As a seasoned software engineer, I have led the development of innovative solutions across various industries, including public safety, retail, and aerospace. At Hexagon, I spearheaded the integration of third-party solutions with a core public safety records management platform, significantly enhancing data flow and system reliability for safety agencies. My expertise in architecting and deploying application code across CJIS and Gov Cloud environments enabled real-time data processing and improved operational efficiency. Additionally, I played a key role in migrating on-premise interfaces to Azure, streamlining deployment processes and enhancing system flexibility.

In the retail sector, I designed and implemented a mobile enrollment flow that greatly improved user experience and application completion rates. My work on automated exception handling workflows and codebase optimization led to faster time-to-market and reduced system errors. I also integrated advanced fraud prevention measures into purchase flows, bolstering transaction security and customer trust.

My experience extends to aerospace, where I developed and deployed critical systems for NASA, enabling real-time data capture and analysis for remote voice operations. I engineered efficient solutions in Bash, Perl, and C++, reducing processing times and resource consumption. My deployment of server clusters across NASA centers unified their communications network, serving as the backbone for ISS and SLS communications. Additionally, I developed robust testing suites and executed comprehensive refactoring plans to enhance system reliability and performance.

I'm always eager to expand my personal and professional network. Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn or contact me directly at cody.d.sanders57@gmail.com.

positions.description: Develop and maintain integrations--along with other software solutions--as part of a Golf Course Management SaaS platform.

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer for Public Safety
positions.description: As a software engineer, I have a proven track record of leading the development of seamless integrations between third-party solutions and a core public safety records management platform, optimizing data flow and enhancing system reliability for safety agencies. I’ve architected and deployed application code across CJIS and Gov Cloud environments, enabling real-time data processing and improving billing metrics. My collaboration with the Cloud Deployment Team led to the migration of on-premise interfaces to Azure, boosting deployment speed and operational efficiency. Additionally, I’ve implemented Azure-driven enhancements to code flexibility, resulting in a decrease in bug reports. I’ve also architected automated Kubernetes workflows, reducing deployment time and allowing for regular feature launches. My work in developing a generalized data service application has refined system interoperability, streamlining the interface development process and accelerating feature deployment, ultimately driving customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft SQL Server · NoSQL · Microsoft Azure · Cloud Services · Docker · Kubernetes · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Powershell · Visual Studio · CJIS · RabbitMQ

positions.title: Software Engineer in eCommerce
positions.description: At CommentSold, I designed and implemented an intuitive mobile enrollment flow for shops, enhancing the user experience and increasing completed applications across platforms. I created an automated exception handling workflow for mobile app submissions, streamlining the process and reducing submission errors, which led to faster time-to-market for client applications. By optimizing the codebase through refactoring core functionalities into modules and interfaces, I facilitated easier testing and integration while reducing coupling conflicts. I integrated Riskified's fraud prevention service into the purchase flow for customers, enhancing transaction security and reducing fraudulent transactions. I also established a new returns workflow using API-driven solutions, improving customer experience and operational efficiency. Additionally, I completed a major integration initiative for inventory management flow, ensuring a flawless launch and enhancing platform reliability for active shops. My development of a robust set of unit tests for critical application functionalities ensured code reliability and reduced the risk of production failures.
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · GitFlow · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Docks · Linux · Agile Methodologies · SQL · Front-End Development · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Back-End Web Development · Back-End · Laravel · PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · DevOps

positions.title: Systems Engineer for NASA Voice Operations
positions.description: I authored precise configuration and deployment processes for remote voice operations systems at NASA, enabling real-time data capture and analysis while bolstering operational decision-making. I engineered efficient solutions in Bash, Perl, and C++ to construct, monitor, and analyze logs for critical NASA voice systems, reducing processing time and resource consumption. I deployed major server clusters across NASA centers, connecting all NASA communications to a single network (IVoDS), which serves as the core of NASA ISS and SLS communications. Additionally, I engineered a Bash script to push Kernel updates across a closed network of IVoDS devices, successfully meeting a tight deployment deadline set by NASA security operations. I also composed a robust Java testing suite to validate new client versions before production deployment, improving system reliability and reducing critical support tickets. Finally, I designed and executed a comprehensive refactoring plan for the Java Asterisk PBX stack, enhancing system performance and allowing for improved handling of large-scale voice operations without performance degradation.
positions.insights: Skills: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Operating Systems · Java · Linux System Administration · Architecture · Code Testing · Customer Support · Computer Networking · Bash · Perl · Shell Scripting

positions.title: Mentee in IT/Systems Administration
positions.description:
-Troubleshoot work-orders submitted by campus faculty to address IT issues

-Act in a help desk capacity to perform IT functions for school campus faculty

-Develop, execute, and maintain scripts for server log management utilizing BASH, PowerShell, and PERL

-Developed parsing programs in PERL to automate functions for IT

-Support REHL and Windows Server based systems used in the campus networking infrastructure

-Fabricated workstations for on-campus school labs

-Assisted with leading the networking infrastructure upgrade from CAT5 to CAT6
